verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents built-in RAG: users attach documents to chat and ask a local model questions about them offline, which yields AI-generated answers grounded in the user's own data. A community user corroborates RAG as a feature. It is user-prompted document Q&A rather than proactive insights or suggestions derived from the user's data. missing for 10: proactive or automatic insight and suggestion generation, analysis of structured or non-document data, documentation of insight or suggestion features beyond chat Q&A, hands-on evidence of the quality of insights from user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: You can attach documents to your chat messages and interact with them entirely offline, also known as "RAG".
LM Studio 0.3.0 comes with built-in functionality to provide a set of document to an LLM and ask questions about them.
LM Studio 0.3.0 supports this with any local model that can run in LM Studio!
